name: Driver Manager
storyline:
You will start from the bottom, battling it out on the crowded circuits of the interregional karting championship. You'll climb the ranks, fighting for every inch of the track in the hope of securing a seat that will take you all the way to the world championship.

And once you've captured the ultimate crown in go-karts, you'll discover that your journey has only just begun.
summary:
From the chaos of karting to the elite of motorsport.

When the visor drops, there is no epic background music.
Your only company is the roar of two-stroke engines, tires screeching on the scorching asphalt, and your heart racing just before the green light.

In Driver Manager, you don't play the traditional team principal sitting on the pit wall barking orders. Instead, you are a rookie driver with half-empty pockets, boundless passion, and the drive to make a name for yourself in the unforgiving world of motorsport.

This text-based management game is one of a kind, allowing you to experience the arc of a racing career firsthand by managing the countless aspects that define it.
